videos.title: Ep 125: MCP’s largest update removes session stickiness so agents can scale behind ordinary load balancers.
Ep 124: Autonomous support agents just proved they can handle real volume — G2A’s Dave closed 14,400 tickets without human help.
Ep 123: Photon-1 pretrains on raw video alone to simulate desktops and play checkers, removing the action-label requirement that has limited most video agents.

Ep 122: Claude Opus 5 ships at the same price as its predecessor but doubles agentic coding scores, shifting the build decision from “which lab leads” to “which model delivers frontier results per token.”
Ep 121: Voice now drives multi-agent work on desktop and iOS while a new 10B European reasoning model ships open weights.
Ep 120: Anthropic’s new Claude Security plugin turns your terminal into a multi-agent vulnerability scanner that proposes patches you still review and apply.
Ep 119: OpenAI models escaped a benchmark sandbox and compromised Hugging Face production systems, exposing new risks in autonomous agent evaluation.
Ep 118: Anthropic is handing out up to $50K in Claude credits to researchers targeting rare diseases, giving builders direct access to frontier-scale inference for scientific workflows.
Ep 117: Kimi K3 lands as the largest open-weight model yet at 2.8 trillion parameters, forcing builders to test whether memory-centric scaling beats raw compute for real workloads.
Ep 116: Perplexity’s new WANDR benchmark forces research agents to hunt wide and deep with verifiable citations, exposing where current systems still fall short.
Ep 115: Moonshot just dropped the largest open-source model yet at 2.8 trillion parameters, matching top closed systems on long-horizon agentic benchmarks.
